nvitk.cluster.sge_remote¶

Stage SGE driver scripts locally and publish them on the cluster via SFTP.

Return (local_write_path, remote_cluster_path) for an SGE driver script.

local_write_path is always on the current machine. remote_cluster_path is the path passed to bash on the cluster login node.
